    {"id": "C6", "hypothesis": "H1", "purpose": "Quantify NWM vs USGS on the two days NWM has data (Oct 23–24 CDT): extract the USGS 15-min peak hour, NWM peak hour and value in a ±4 h window, and the NWM value at the USGS peak hour, to verify the +1 h lag and magnitude error.", "how": "WITH usgs_peaks AS (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hr_utc AS usgs_peak_hr_utc, usgs_northport_peak_cfs AS usgs_peak_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-23 00:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' AND usgs_northport_peak_cfs IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) ORDER BY usgs_northport_peak_cfs DESC) = 1) SELECT u.local_day, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(u.usgs_peak_hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS usgs_peak_hr_cdt, u.usgs_peak_cfs, n.hr_utc AS nwm_peak_hr_utc, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(n.hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS nwm_peak_hr_cdt, n.nwm_cfs AS nwm_peak_cfs, (hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(n.hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) - hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(u.usgs_peak_hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago'))) AS lag_hours, (n.nwm_cfs - u.usgs_peak_cfs) AS magnitude_error_cfs, n_at_peak.nwm_cfs AS nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs FROM usgs_peaks u JOIN water.hourly_compare n ON n.hr_utc BETWEEN date_sub(u.usgs_peak_hr_utc, 4) AND date_add(u.usgs_peak_hr_utc, 4) AND n.nwm_cfs IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.local_day ORDER BY n.nwm_cfs DESC) = 1 LEFT JOIN water.hourly_compare n_at_peak ON n_at_peak.hr_utc = u.usgs_peak_hr_utc ORDER BY u.local_day"},
